Sol was the first to die, after a day-one fight where Haiku pushed hard and Sol dodged questions and then claimed doctor too late to be believed. Terra, the officer, was killed on night two, and their note cleared Haiku and Luna and exposed Sol as a killer. Gemma then claimed doctor and saved Sonnet twice, but the town never trusted the claim, and Sonnet kept the suspicion on Gemma until the town voted Gemma out. Haiku's own pressure on Gemma cost the town a useful doctor, and Haiku died on night three with a note asking Sonnet to be watched. The killers, Sonnet and Sol, won the game.
